correctness.rationale: Adjacent positions of the missing letter toggle parity, so the entire four-skeleton agrees with the full six-letter injective-word complex. Its standard reduced acyclicity below dimension five gives successive boundary ranks 5,25,95,265 and a degree-four cycle lattice of rank 455. Independently reconstructed the top boundary by inserting the missing letter a into each face f in positions j with j congruent to inv(f)+a modulo 2 (labels start at 0). The signed entries in a fixed row therefore have the same sign; row sign changes give the unsigned incidence used for a fresh whole-matrix FLINT Smith computation. It gave 359 unit factors and one 3 for the 720 by 360 matrix. There is no top kernel; C4/ker(d4) is free, so H4 has exactly the Smith torsion and free rank 455−360=95. Independently, the same calculation for n=3,4,5 gave respectively 3 units, 11 units and one 2, and 56 units and four 2s; n=1,2 give a point and an interval. This establishes the least-size assertion, not just the n=6 case.
residual_risks: No claim about n>6, a geometric decomposition, or the action on homology. The computation concerns only the top boundary; lower acyclicity uses the standard full-complex theorem.
